description: Real photographs used by seed_demo instead of the generated sample photos of their category. 'after' (optional) is the same spot after the repair. 'severity' and 'box' (normalised [x1, y1, x2, y2] defect region) are manual annotations; 'author', 'license' and 'source_url' credit the photo (see CREDITS.md).

sources.drainage: Wikimedia Commons - waterlogged streets, open drains and nalas (mostly India); photographer and licence of every photo below
sources.fallen_tree: Wikimedia Commons - storm-felled trees on roads and streets (mostly UK, also Moscow and Taipei); photographer and licence of every photo below
sources.garbage: Urban Civic Issues Image Dataset: Potholes and Garbage (QR4Change) by Yash Maske, Shubhankar Jakate, Chandrakant Thakare and Sakshi Lokhande, Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/zndzygc3p3.2, CC BY 4.0 - phone photos from Pune
sources.open_manhole: A Real-World Road Dataset For Manhole and Speed Breaker Detection in Bangladesh by Md Mijanur Rahman et al. (Southeast University, Dhaka), Mendeley Data V1, doi:10.17632/7zzcmv2wz7.1, CC BY 4.0 - 'Uncovered_Manhole' folder
sources.other: Wikimedia Commons - stray cattle and stray dogs on streets (mostly India); photographer and licence of every photo below
sources.pothole: Urban Civic Issues Image Dataset: Potholes and Garbage (QR4Change) by Yash Maske, Shubhankar Jakate, Chandrakant Thakare and Sakshi Lokhande, Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/zndzygc3p3.2, CC BY 4.0 - only the authors' own phone photos from Pune (the folder also holds web images with stock-photo watermarks, which were left out)
sources.road_crack: Road Classification dataset ('Broken' folder), supplied by the project author as archive.zip
sources.streetlight: Wikimedia Commons - knocked-down, bent and damaged street-light poles (Netherlands, UK, USA, Spain) and street lights in India; photographer and licence of every photo below
sources.water_leak: Wikimedia Commons - burst water mains and leaking pipes (UK, USA, New Zealand); photographer and licence of every photo below
